notes: Recipe is in the video only — full steps not accessible in text. Hashtags: #BettyCrocker #Kelloggs #baking. Comments confirm: uses a Betty Crocker cookie mix (various flavors work), combined with Kellogg's cereal (Rice Krispies or Cocoa Krispies). To press into pan without sticking: butter your hands, or run hands under water. Commenter Donna Rash shared an alternative no-bake version: 1 cup lite Karo syrup + 1 cup sugar, bring to boil, remove from heat, add 1 cup peanut butter, stir, add 6 cups Rice Krispies, press into greased 9x13 pan, frost with melted butterscotch chips + ½ bag chocolate chips.
